review: 119.4b-1: variant no-emperion had the same outcome as the base and flipped nothing; dropped it.
119.8-2: had no does_not_fire variant; no-emperion (the exchange happens) relabelled from other to does_not_fire.
119.5-1: base expected a +1/+1 counter from Ajani's Pridemate but no decision resolved its trigger; added that decision.
119.6-1: nothing exercised the 'or less' half of 119.6; added variant below-zero (B at 1 life ends at -1 and loses).

scenarios.title: Combat damage dealt to a player makes that player lose that much life

setup.notes: Neither player has any poison counters.

decisions: A attacks B with A's Grizzly Bears only.
B declares no blockers.
Both players pass through the declare blockers step; combat damage is dealt.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A's Grizzly Bears deals 2 combat damage to B; B's life total goes from 20 to 18 and B has no poison counters.

variants.label: infect-attacker
variants.delta: A attacks with Glistener Elf (1/1 infect) instead of Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: Glistener Elf deals 1 combat damage to B; B's life total stays 20 and B gets 1 poison counter.

variants.label: blocked
variants.delta: B declares B's Grizzly Bears as a blocker of A's attacking Grizzly Bears.
variants.expected: The damage goes to the blocking creature, not to B; B's life total stays 20; both Grizzly Bears have lethal damage and move to their owners' graveyards.

scenarios.title: An effect that causes life loss and life gain adjusts the life totals by the amounts
decisions: A casts Exsanguinate with X=3, tapping all five Swamps.
Both players pass; Exsanguinate resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Exsanguinate resolves: B loses 3 life (20 to 17) and A gains the 3 life lost (20 to 23).

variants.label: x-zero
variants.delta: A casts Exsanguinate with X=0, tapping two Swamps.
variants.expected: Exsanguinate resolves: B loses 0 life and A gains 0 life; both life totals stay 20.

scenarios.title: A life payment is allowed only if the life total is at least the payment (Phyrexian mana)

setup.notes: A controls no lands and has no other mana source, so the {G/P} in Mutagenic Growth's cost can only be paid with 2 life.

decisions: A tries to cast Mutagenic Growth targeting A's Grizzly Bears, paying {G/P} with 2 life.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting is legal (A has 5 life, at least 2). Paying lowers A's life total to 3, and Mutagenic Growth goes on the stack.

variants.label: exactly-enough
variants.expected: Casting is legal (A has 2 life, equal to the payment). Paying lowers A's life total to 0, so A loses the game in the next state-based check.

variants.label: one-short
variants.expected: Casting is not legal: A has 1 life, less than the 2 life payment. Mutagenic Growth stays in hand and A's life total stays 1.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge lets the human pay Phyrexian mana with life only if getLife() >= 2; the AI may decline to do so even when legal.

scenarios.title: A pay-X-life additional cost is allowed only if the life total is at least X
decisions: A tries to cast Hatred with X=3 targeting A's Grizzly Bears, tapping all five Swamps and paying 3 life.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting is legal (A has 3 life, equal to X). A's life total becomes 0, Hatred is on the stack, and A loses the game in the next state-based check.

variants.label: x-too-large
variants.delta: A tries to cast Hatred with X=4 instead of X=3.
variants.expected: Casting is not legal: the 4 life payment exceeds A's 3 life. Hatred stays in hand, the Swamps stay untapped and A's life total stays 3.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge bounds the announced X by what the life payment allows; the verdict may appear as X being unselectable rather than as a rejected cast.

scenarios.title: Paying 0 life is always possible, even when the player's life total cannot change

setup.notes: Platinum Emperion: A's life total can't change, so A can't pay any life except 0.

decisions: A tries to cast Hatred with X=0 targeting B's Grizzly Bears, tapping all five Swamps.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting is legal: the payment of 0 life is allowed. Hatred goes on the stack and A's life total stays 20.

variants.label: pay-one
variants.delta: A tries to cast Hatred with X=1 instead of X=0.
variants.expected: Casting is not legal: A can't pay 1 life while Platinum Emperion keeps A's life total from changing. Hatred stays in hand.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge may hide X=1 from the announcement instead of rejecting the cast.

scenarios.title: Setting a life total makes the player gain or lose the difference

setup.notes: Ajani's Pridemate (2/2) shows whether a life gain event occurred.

decisions: A casts Blessed Wind targeting A, tapping all nine Plains.
Both players pass; Blessed Wind resolves.
If Ajani's Pridemate triggers, both players pass and the trigger resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: A's life total becomes 20 by gaining 12 life (8 to 20). Ajani's Pridemate triggers and gets a +1/+1 counter (3/3).

variants.label: above
variants.expected: A's life total becomes 20 by losing 10 life (30 to 20). Ajani's Pridemate does not trigger and stays 2/2.

variants.label: equal
variants.expected: A's life total stays 20: no life is gained or lost. Ajani's Pridemate does not trigger and stays 2/2.

scenarios.title: A player with 0 or less life loses the game as a state-based action
decisions: A casts Shock targeting B, tapping Mountain.
Both players pass; Shock resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to B; B's life total is 0 and B loses the game in the next state-based check.

variants.label: one-life-left
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to B; B's life total is 1 and the game continues.

variants.label: below-zero
variants.expected: Shock deals 2 damage to B; B's life total is -1 and B loses the game in the next state-based check.

scenarios.title: With a can't-gain-life effect, an exchange that would raise the life total does not happen

setup.notes: Tree of Redemption is a 0/13. Leyline of Punishment: players can't gain life.

decisions: A activates Tree of Redemption ({T}: exchange A's life total with its toughness).
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The exchange would raise A's life total from 5 to 13, so it does not happen: A's life total stays 5 and Tree of Redemption's toughness stays 13.

variants.label: exchange-lowers
variants.expected: The exchange would lower A's life total, so it happens: A's life total becomes 13 and Tree of Redemption's toughness becomes 20.

variants.label: no-leyline
variants.delta: Leyline of Punishment is not on the battlefield (A's life total is 5 as in the base).
variants.expected: The exchange happens: A's life total becomes 13 and Tree of Redemption's toughness becomes 5.

scenarios.forge_notes: LifeExchangeVariantEffect checks canGainLife and canLoseLife before exchanging.

scenarios.title: A cost that involves paying life can't be paid by a player who can't lose life

setup.notes: A controls no lands, so the {G/P} in Mutagenic Growth's cost can only be paid with 2 life. Platinum Emperion: A's life total can't change.

decisions: A tries to cast Mutagenic Growth targeting A's Grizzly Bears, paying {G/P} with 2 life.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Casting is not legal: the 2 life payment can't be made. Mutagenic Growth stays in hand and A's life total stays 20.

variants.label: no-emperion
variants.delta: Platinum Emperion is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: Casting is legal. Paying lowers A's life total to 18 and Mutagenic Growth goes on the stack.

scenarios.title: With a can't-lose-life effect, an exchange that would lower the life total does not happen

setup.notes: Tree of Perdition is a 0/13. Platinum Emperion: B's life total can't change.

decisions: A activates Tree of Perdition ({T}: exchange target opponent's life total with its toughness), targeting B.
Both players pass; the ability resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: The exchange would lower B's life total from 20 to 13, so it does not happen: B's life total stays 20 and Tree of Perdition's toughness stays 13.

variants.label: no-emperion
variants.delta: Platinum Emperion is not on the battlefield.
variants.expected: The exchange happens: B's life total becomes 13 and Tree of Perdition's toughness becomes 20.

scenarios.forge_notes: Forge has no pure can't-lose-life effect, so Platinum Emperion (CantChangeLife) is used; it also stops gains, which is irrelevant because the exchange here would only lower.

scenarios.title: A whenever-you-gain-life trigger fires on a gain of more than 0 life and not on a gain of 0

setup.notes: Sanguine Bond: whenever you gain life, target opponent loses that much life.

decisions: A casts Exsanguinate with X=2, tapping all four Swamps.
Both players pass; Exsanguinate resolves.
If Sanguine Bond triggers, it targets B; both players pass and it resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: Exsanguinate makes B lose 2 and A gain 2 (A 22, B 18). Sanguine Bond triggers on the gain of 2 and B loses 2 more life, ending at 16.

variants.label: gain-zero
variants.delta: A casts Exsanguinate with X=0, tapping two Swamps.
variants.expected: Exsanguinate makes B lose 0 and A gain 0 life. Sanguine Bond does not trigger; both life totals stay 20.

variants.label: other-controller
variants.delta: Sanguine Bond is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: A gains 2 and B loses 2 (A 22, B 18). Sanguine Bond does not trigger because B did not gain life; life totals stay at 22 and 18.

scenarios.title: A would-gain-life replacement effect applies to a gain of more than 0 life and does nothing on a gain of 0

setup.notes: Angel of Vitality: if you would gain life, you gain that much life plus 1 instead.

decisions: A casts Exsanguinate with X=2, tapping all four Swamps.
Both players pass; Exsanguinate resolves.

variants.label: base
variants.expected: B loses 2 life (20 to 18). The gain of 2 is replaced: A gains 3 life instead (20 to 23).

variants.label: gain-zero
variants.delta: A casts Exsanguinate with X=0, tapping two Swamps.
variants.expected: B loses 0 life and no life gain event occurs, so the replacement does not apply: A's life total stays 20 (not 21).

variants.label: other-controller
variants.delta: Angel of Vitality is controlled by B instead of A.
variants.expected: A gains exactly 2 life (20 to 22) and B loses 2 (20 to 18); the replacement does not apply to A.
